description: An append-only record of every message the Accountant Agent tried to send, including the ones that were refused. A message cannot be unsent, so 'no error was raised' is not evidence it went - the provider's own message id, recorded here, is. The unique idempotency key is what stops a retried request sending the same email twice.

fields.label: Idempotency Key
fields.description: Unique per intended message. A retry carrying the same key returns the original receipt instead of sending again.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: SENT means the provider accepted it and gave us an id. REFUSED means this site would not send it. FAILED means the provider rejected it.

fields.label: Destination
fields.description: The email address, or the Telegram chat id.

fields.label: Destination Name
fields.description: For Telegram, the name the destination was listed under.

fields.label: Body (first 500 characters)
fields.description: Truncated on purpose. This log is for proving what was sent to whom, not for storing a second copy of the customer's correspondence.

fields.label: Approved By
fields.description: The person who agreed to this being sent. Empty where the request itself named the destination, which is its own approval.

fields.label: Provider Message ID
fields.description: Gmail's message id, or Telegram's. This is the only proof the message was actually accepted.

name: Agent Message Log
